data.notes: March 2026 was unusually stacked for Melbourne/Naarm, with Labour Day weekend festivals, major arena touring, K-pop, hip-hop and several high-grade electronic club bookings.

events.title: Brunswick Music Festival 2026
events.summary: Merri-bek City Council’s week-long Brunswick Music Festival returned with Sydney Road Street Party, international headline acts, local venue shows and a free outdoor concert at Gilpin Park.

events.title: ATEEZ — In Your Fantasy Tour
events.summary: K-pop group ATEEZ brought the In Your Fantasy Tour to Rod Laver Arena for two Melbourne arena dates.

events.title: Pitch Music & Arts 2026
events.summary: Pitch Music & Arts returned to Moyston for its ninth edition with Charlotte de Witte, Eris Drew & Octo Octa, MARRØN, Girls Don’t Sync, Job Jobse, Yung Singh and a large international electronic lineup.

events.title: Hilltop Hoods — Never Coming Home Tour
events.summary: Australian hip-hop mainstays Hilltop Hoods played two Rod Laver Arena dates on the Never Coming Home Tour.

events.title: In The Moment Radio — Launch Weekender
events.summary: Zepherin Saint launched In The Moment Radio with a two-night program at The Quadraphonic Club, including François K, Finn Rees Ensemble, Ella Thompson, Soul Chamber Trio and Mike Gurrieri.

events.title: Golden Plains Eighteen
events.summary: Golden Plains Eighteen took over Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre with a one-stage lineup headed by Basement Jaxx, Marlon Williams, Smerz, Cut Copy, BadBadNotGood, Ty Segall, DJRUM and more.

events.title: Linkin Park — From Zero World Tour
events.summary: Linkin Park’s From Zero World Tour stopped at Rod Laver Arena for Melbourne arena shows across 8–10 March.

events.title: 2026 [안녕, MELBOURNE] Music Festival
events.summary: APPLEWOOD and Untitled Group staged the one-day 안녕, MELBOURNE K-pop festival at Flemington Racecourse, with ENHYPEN, TREASURE and TAEMIN promoted across official event listings.

events.title: Paul Woolford — Revolver Fridays & Dance Technique
events.summary: Revolver Upstairs hosted Paul Woolford for a Friday night Revolver Fridays and Dance Technique session, with local support across the Cage and Stage rooms.

events.title: Reminisce 2026
events.summary: Hardware Presents brought Reminisce back to the Sidney Myer Music Bowl for a full day of house, rave and nostalgia, with Felix Da Housecat, Digitalism, Princess Superstar, CJ Bolland and Thomas Schumacher listed on RA.

events.title: Wu-Tang Clan — Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber
events.summary: Wu-Tang Clan brought the Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber tour to Rod Laver Arena for a major Melbourne hip-hop arena date.

events.title: DISCOLEIL ft JNETT, Jesse Boyd
events.summary: DISCOLEIL returned to Riviera Beach Club in Elwood with DJ JNETT, Jesse Boyd, Wunderkind, Peter Apostle, Von Emyl, Michaél Beaty and Marcelo for an afternoon-to-evening disco and house party.
